entities.name: Vannemir
entities.description: A humble warrior from Terisiare who is killed by orcs, resurrected by Ysidra, and accepts the task of rescuing a mysterious elven girl.

entities.name: Ysidra
entities.description: A winged valkyrie who resurrects Vannemir and shows him the future if he refuses his destiny.

entities.name: Taaveti
entities.description: A long-lived elven hunter who gives Vannemir the Runeblade and guides him to the Torgash trail.

entities.name: Pik
entities.description: A blind boy of about twelve whose sister was taken by the orcs.

entities.name: Isa
entities.description: A snow leopard fylgja spirit bound to the Runeblade that merges with Vannemir.

entities.name: Runeblade
entities.description: An ancient sword with a powerful fylgja bound to it, given to Vannemir by way of Ysidra.

entities.name: Guldark
entities.description: The Torgash orc warlord who raided Vannemir's village and held the prisoners; killed by Vannemir.

entities.name: Heidar
entities.description: A wizard shown in Vannemir's visions who seeks to keep the world in ice forever and would rule Terisiare.

entities.name: Torgash
entities.description: An orc clan led by Guldark that raids villages.

entities.name: Graks
entities.description: An orc clan in Guldark's camp who put out Pik's eyes and killed his father.

entities.name: Cult of Rimewind
entities.description: The wizards led by Heidar who seek to keep the land covered in ice.

entities.name: The Thaw
entities.description: The thawing of the ice age that Heidar wants forgotten.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: The icy continent of Dominaria where the story takes place.

entities.name: Darien
entities.description: King of Kjeldor, seen killed in Vannemir's vision of the future.

entities.name: Valharad
entities.description: Vannemir's father, whom he longs to see again.

events.summary: Vannemir and the blind boy Pik catch up with Guldark's Torgash band and Vannemir surveys their encampment.
events.quote: they had finally caught up with Guldark and his band of Torgash butchers

events.summary: Pik explains the Graks killed his father and blinded him two years ago.
events.quote: They are the ones that killed my pa two years ago and put my eyes out.

events.summary: Flashback: Vannemir is cut down by an orc axe while defending his village from the Torgash raiders.
events.quote: Cut down by an orcish axe while he stood defending his village from their raiders

events.summary: Flashback: the valkyrie Ysidra appears to the dying Vannemir and carries him to her domain.
events.quote: Vannemir, son of Valharad

events.summary: Vannemir awakes healed of all wounds on a stone slab in the Valkyrie's domed hall.
events.quote: He also noticed that his wounds had vanished

events.summary: Ysidra tells Vannemir his time on earth is not complete and that he must do one more task before joining his forefathers.
events.quote: Your time upon the earth is not yet complete

events.summary: Ysidra shows Vannemir a vision of Heidar and the Thaw.
events.quote: He seeks to keep the world encased in ice until the end of time

events.summary: Vannemir sees orc warlords and Heidar's army destroying settlement after settlement across Terisiare.
events.quote: Settlement after settlement was extirpated from the face of Terisiare

events.summary: Vannemir sees the future in which Darien is killed at the battle for Kjeld.
events.quote: a lethal arc of cryomantic energy blasted him off of his horse and hurled him into a wall

events.summary: Vannemir sees Heidar made ruler of Terisiare and the land plunged into endless winter.
events.quote: Then he saw Heidar lifted up as ruler of Terisiare and all bowed to his terrible power

events.summary: Vannemir wakes in a snowy forest where the elf Taaveti finds him.
events.quote: Vannemir came to in a forest of evergreens covered in snow and ice

events.summary: Taaveti introduces himself and says Ysidra gave him the sword to give to Vannemir.
events.quote: Ysidra gave me the sword to give to you

events.summary: Taaveti explains Vannemir must rescue a prisoner on whom Terisiare's fate hangs.
events.quote: He was to rescue the prisoner at all costs

events.summary: Taaveti warns that a fylgja is bound to the Runeblade and may try to take over Vannemir's soul.
events.quote: there is a Fylgja bound to it

events.summary: Taaveti leads Vannemir to the Torgash trail at a ruined settlement.
events.quote: Taaveti had brought them to the trail

events.summary: Taaveti and Vannemir find the blind boy Pik hidden under the floor of a burned hovel.
events.quote: They both cleared the debris away and hauled open the door that revealed a small boy of about twelve

events.summary: Taaveti leaves Pik in Vannemir's care and departs for the woods of Yavimaya.
events.quote: My duty is done here, round-ear, and now I am bound for the woods of Yavimaya

events.summary: Vannemir and Pik track the orcs for several days and find the warlord's camp.
events.quote: Eventually, at the mouth of a cavern, they find him.

events.summary: Vannemir draws the Runeblade and the fylgja's silver fire runs through him.
events.quote: Silver fire ran down the blade from tip to hilt, igniting runes

events.summary: Vannemir meets the snow leopard spirit and merges with the fylgja.
events.quote: I will become you. Prepare.

events.summary: The fylgja declares it is one with Vannemir and Vannemir learns to call it Isa.
events.quote: What do I call you?

events.summary: Vannemir kills two Torgash guards bare-handed and enters the camp.
events.quote: He moved in, dispatching two guards like a phantom with his bare hands

events.summary: Vannemir leaps into the camp, cuts through the Torgash and finds two chained girls, a human and an elf.
events.quote: until he found them, bound by chains and left in the snow, two girls, a human and an elf

events.summary: Vannemir is gashed across the back, but Isa draws on the land to heal him.
events.quote: His wound sealed up. Vannemir stood.

events.summary: An orc shaman warns Guldark that Vannemir bears the mark of a fylgja.
events.quote: This one has the mark of a Fylgja upon him

events.summary: Guldark smashes Vannemir with his club and the shaman's spells drain him, but Isa knits him back together.
events.quote: He felt his bones splinter as he was launched into the air like a stone from a catapult

events.summary: Vannemir beheads the orc shaman.
events.quote: The hag raised her spellcasting claw, only to watch it flip through the air like some misshapen bird, closely followed by her gibbering head

events.summary: Vannemir kills Guldark and the Torgash flee.
events.quote: cleaving Guldark from stem to stern

events.summary: Vannemir leads the rescued girls back to Pik, who is reunited with his sister.
events.quote: Vannemir found the girls huddled in the forest and he led them back to where Pik was waiting anxiously

relations.quote: cleaving Guldark from stem to stern
the camp had alerted their warlord, Guldark
He is the Master of Rimewind
My name is Taaveti of Kelsinko.

relations.note: Resurrects Vannemir and gives him his task.
relations.quote: but resurrected by the valkyrie Ysidra

relations.note: The fylgja is bound to the sword.
relations.quote: there is a Fylgja bound to it

relations.note: They killed his father and blinded him.
relations.quote: They are the ones that killed my pa two years ago and put my eyes out.
